mlkem-selkie

Rust ML-KEM (FIPS 203) — beautiful, secure code.

Conformance

  • Wycheproof (C2SP) — all 12 ML-KEM files
  • NIST ACVP FIPS 203 KATs (keyGen + encapDecap)
  • libcrux interop — 512 / 768 / 1024
  • BoringSSL interop oracle (opt-in)

Quality gates

  • fmt · clippy (default + all-features)
  • rustdoc (private items, deny warnings)
  • proptest property suites
  • cargo-mutants on every PR diff

Performance

  • divan wall-clock (public + internal)
  • gungraun callgrind instruction counts
  • rdtsc megacycles (x86_64)
  • dhat heap profiling example
